name: Pokémon Survivor Burst
summary:
Pokémon Survivors Burst is a free, unofficial Pokémon fan game focused on survival-action gameplay. Players control a Pokémon directly while facing increasingly dangerous enemy waves, gaining experience and choosing upgrades and abilities throughout each run. The game features multiple playable characters, progression challenges, boss encounters, Classic and Rush game modes, and online leaderboards.
Pokémon Survivors Burst is a non-commercial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures Inc. or The Pokémon Company.
